test_cases.test_case_title: Teacher Creates a New File Group with a Valid Title
test_cases.pre_condition: A teacher with a pre-provisioned account is logged in and has navigated to the 'Files' tab of a specific course, and the 'New File Group' modal is open.
test_cases.expected_result: A new file group with the title 'Reference Materials' appears in the file tree. The system displays the updated file structure, confirming the successful creation of the file group. The outcome is successful (True).
test_cases.post_condition: The new file group 'Reference Materials' exists in the course's file tree on the 'Files' tab.
